model_annotation: Figure 5 presents a grouped bar chart illustrating the dynamics of vineyard area planted with wine grapes in the seven leading wine-producing countries over the period from 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis, labeled “Години” (Years), displays the years sequentially from 2013 to 2022 in chronological order. The vertical axis, labeled “Хиляди хектари” (Thousands of Hectares), is scaled linearly, ranging from 0 to 1200, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 200, and the unit of measurement is explicitly stated as thousands of hectares. Each year on the horizontal axis contains seven grouped bars, each representing one of the seven countries as indicated by the legend: Испания (Spain, blue), Франция (France, orange), Китай/континентален/ (China/Continental/, gray), Италия (Italy, yellow), Турция (Turkey, light blue), САЩ (USA, green), and Аржентина (Argentina, dark blue). The bars are arranged in the order specified in the legend, which follows the sequence: Spain, France, China/Continental/, Italy, Turkey, USA, Argentina. The height of each bar corresponds to the vineyard area for that specific country in that year, with the tallest bars generally exceeding 800 thousand hectares and the shortest bars generally below 200 thousand hectares. The bars for each year are visually grouped side-by-side without any stacking or cumulative representation, and no individual bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or other highlighting techniques.
